facts.summary: Interim response rates modest (26% TSC1, 11% TSC2 arms) · Phase 2 · nab-sirolimus in TSC1/TSC2-altered solid tumors · not yet approved
facts.indication: solid tumors with TSC1 or TSC2 inactivating alterations

evidence.summary: An 11% ORR including 2 PRs with 1 confirmed and 1 uPR
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: The primary endpoint is overall response rate per independent radiographic review (IRR) using RECIST v1.1.
evidence.safety: No new safety signals were observed, and no grade four treatment-related events or deaths occurred.
